# has unit

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasUnit>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Relates a quantitative value or measurement to its QUDT unit (by reference, never imported). Domain-free: used by temporal measurements, spatial measurements, and any other quantified claim.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`qudt:Unit`](http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/Unit); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md) from `?` to [`qudt:Unit`](http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/Unit) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
